GLOBAL EXACT BOUNDED-K CRT SUMMARY
========================================================================================================================
  total interval-model cases       = 952
  true K contained in bound        = 136/952
  exact-tail cases                 = 0
  exact-tail survivors counted     = 0
  unique bounded-K cases           = 0

CRT LOCAL DENSITY
  odd-prime product density = 1.870575245188e-02

For large b:
  2-adic density -> 1/6
  full density   -> 3.117625408647e-03

INTERPRETATION

  Experiment 442R2 showed that the pure 2-adic K-image
  asymptotically retains about one sixth of all K residues.

  Experiment 443 adds the odd-prime quadratic-residue
  constraints and asks the more important bounded question:

      how many K values remain inside a justified finite bound?

  The CRT period is handled arithmetically. No complete
  CRT residue set is materialized.

  If exact bounded populations remain huge, then residue
  information alone cannot practically determine K.

  If a genuinely justified bound produces a very small
  population, that becomes the next reconstruction target.

  The natural bounds are hypotheses used for measurement.
  They are not themselves a factoring theorem.

  A unique survivor would still require the independent
  exact factor/gap reconstruction check before being accepted.
